laraib.name: Laraib
laraib.title: To My Dearest Friend on Your 24th Birthday
content: You have been w me in the midst of chaos, when i couldn’t find myself to speak you sat quietly, shouted when you felt like i wasn’t doing enough, talked to me when i needed the most. You have been through hell yourself but never fail to make me feel better even on the days when you feel down. Its sad that this might be your last birthday in pakistan and im not there nor i can do anything to make it special for you but i promise one day i will. I will meet you like i promised you. I will be there like i have always been. Im so glad Allah chose you to be in my life otherwise i would’nt have ever understood what its like to have a friend in this world. I pray that i meet u in another world as well. You as my sister in that universe too because i cant think of another sister if its not you. Tho sometimes we cant bear the sight of each other. I have made mistakes which i will be sorry for, for the rest of my life but i wont ever leave you until the end of the world. I genuinely dont have any words to describe this bond but im glad i have you as my sister, because until my last breath i know there is someone by my side no matter what. I have said it before ill say it again. You have the purest heart on this planet. Its sad because you wont be there when i go back to pakistan now. Kills me. But thats how life is. I hope we can meet as much as we discuss. I hope life doesn’t let us fall apart from each other because that would kill me idk why tf did i say that but ok, he love you have for animals the shelter you want them to be in. I hope you build that. I hope life treats you in a much kinder way when im not around so you get bored and call me all the time, some friendships feel like they were written long before we were even born, and yours is exactly that. So here’s to you, to your day, your journey, your strength, and the impact you don’t even realize you’ve had on my life. Distance or no distance, I’m rooting for you in ways even you don’t fully understand. Happiest birthday dobby❤
